image_description: A cluster of stylized, graffiti-covered street signs mounted on a single metal pole against a cloudy sky. The signs include a yellow directional arrow pointing left with black text, a yellow rectangular sign with blue and black markings, a blue rectangular sign with white text, and a red octagonal stop-sign shape at the bottom with white text. The text appears to be in a non-Latin script or heavily stylized gibberish.
